# QTranslate Windows Installer UpgradeCode.
#
# This UUID is the product's stable Windows upgrade identity. Changing it
# breaks in-place Windows upgrades: a different value makes every future MSI
# install side-by-side with the old one instead of replacing it.
#
# Never regenerate it - not per build, not per release, not per major version.
